DeployBot: alert: embeddings p95 +28% vs baseline after v3.6.1 rollout. auto-revert score=0.7 :warning:
Alex H: acknowledged. which tenants affected?
DeployBot: dedicated-pool-3 (3 tenants). hosted unaffected. error-rate normal. regression on similarity eval.
Sara P: propose a soft-unwind: stop routing new embed requests to v3.6.1 for that pool and pin them back to v3.6.0.
Mike L: agreed — dedicated customers require manual comms before any automated revert.
Emma R: I'll prepare a concise customer note and update the release notes.
Alex H: decision? let auto-revert run or manual?
Sara P: manual. confidence too low for auto. we'll do manual rollback for dedicated-pool-3 only.
Mike L: runbook: (1) pin v3.6.0 to pool, (2) rollback pool to v3.6.0, (3) run smoke similarity test on canary, (4) notify customers. Who owns steps?
Alex H: I'll execute pin+rollback. Sara does QA smoke. Emma does communications.
DeployBot: suggested commands:
```
redwood release pin v3.6.0 --targets=dedicated-pool-3
redwood deploy rollback --to v3.6.0 --scope=dedicated-pool-3
```
OncallBot: reminder: change window open until 23:00 UTC. if rollback crosses, notify ops and customers.
Alex H: executing pin now.
Alex H: pin success. starting rollback in 90s.
Alex H: rollback finished.
Sara P: smoke: embed similarity within 1.3% of baseline on canary tenant, logs look clean.
Emma R: sending customer note: "We observed a regression in embedding similarity for a small set of dedicated tenants after the recent model update. We reverted those tenants to v3.6.0 and are investigating. Expect follow-up from our engineering team."
Mike L: please open a postmortem ticket and loop legal if SLA credits are possible.
Alex H: PM-4527 created and assigned to eng-ml + infra: https://pm.internal/4527
Sara P: next actions: run v3.6.1-q in staging with full embedding eval before any re-rollout.
DeployBot: audit log: manual rollback by Alex H, auto-revert suppressed per operator request.
Emma R: solid coordination, thanks all. :clap:
Alex H: closing thread once PM posted.
